MK-CF-F-188: Multiplies every monthly contribution by 12 although householdK401ByMonth counts contributions only in paid months.
MK-CF-F-169: Writing a known amount is correct, but blank becomes an explicit 0 and destroys the distinction between clearing a cell and entering zero.

formula_checks.name: hasWage
formula_checks.why: Presence detector: a stored table is evidence of a wage record even when an explicit row is zero; this does not assert positive pay.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: earnerWages
formula_checks.why: Honors the explicit who-earns selection and uses the spouse’s own wage record; no household sum is substituted into a person’s row.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: hasTwoEarners
formula_checks.why: True exactly when the selected wage list has two records, rather than from marital status alone.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: sumOverEarners
formula_checks.why: Adding known values is correct, but a missing figure becomes 0 without completeness metadata.
formula_checks.should_be: Return the known subtotal with missing-item metadata, or refuse the complete total.

formula_checks.name: sumMonthsOverEarners
formula_checks.why: Adds the same calendar slots across the earners; an explicit zero month remains zero.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: householdPreTaxContributionsAnnual
formula_checks.why: Multiplies every monthly contribution by 12 although householdK401ByMonth counts contributions only in paid months.
formula_checks.should_be: Add the twelve values of householdK401ByMonth.

formula_checks.name: monthKey
formula_checks.why: Uses the person’s local calendar month; UTC date conversion must not change it. Cases include offset crossings.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: monthWindow
formula_checks.why: Calendar arithmetic across year boundaries; count is a nonnegative integer and back is an integer.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: salaryMonths
